title: KoAGE: Do Large Language Models Know, Learn, and Coin Korean Neologisms?
abstract: arXiv:2610.19399v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Korean neologisms arise through diverse mechanisms, a demanding test of language models beyond lexical memorization. To enable systematic evaluation, we introduce NeoTrace, an automated, rerunnable framework that collects and dates neologisms across genres. Its 4,271 entries support KoAGE, a cutoff-aware benchmark with three acquisition and two generation tasks---the latter, to our knowledge, the first to compare model coinages with attested neologisms under their original materials and community context. Across 21 models, lexical recall diverges from contextual inference: in a five-model temporal analysis, models define only 13-30% of cutoff-year words, yet can infer meaning from one usage. However, structural understanding remains limited: even correct definitions barely improve formation analysis of pre-cutoff neologisms. translated_title: KoAGE：大语言模型了解、学习并创造韩语新词吗？
translated_abstract: 韩语新词通过多种机制产生，这对语言模型而言是一项超越单纯词汇记忆的严苛考验。为实现系统化评估，我们提出了NeoTrace——一个可重复运行的自动化框架，用于跨文体收集新词并确定其出现时间。该框架收集的4,271条词条支撑了KoAGE基准，这是一个具有时间截止意识的评测基准，包含三项习得任务和两项生成任务，其中后者据我们所知是首个在原始材料和社区语境下将模型造词与真实存在的新词进行对比的评测。在对21个模型的评估中，词汇记忆与语境推断表现出明显分化：在针对五个模型的时间序列分析中，模型只能对截止年份新词中的13-30%给出定义，但能够从单个用法实例中推断出词义。然而，结构理解仍然有限：即使是正确的定义也几乎无法提升对截止日期前新词构词方式的分析能力。在给定构词材料的情况下，单个模型通常能遵循人类的构词机制，而多智能体造词……
tldr: 该研究提出NeoTrace自动化框架与KoAGE基准，系统评估大语言模型对韩语新词的认知与创造能力，发现模型虽能从语境中推断新词含义，但对构词结构的理解仍存在明显局限。
en_tdlr: This study introduces NeoTrace and the KoAGE benchmark to systematically evaluate large language models' knowledge and coinage of Korean neologisms, finding that while models can infer meanings from context, their structural understanding of word formation remains limited.
